name: progress
title: Progress
description: How far a task has come: the switch's sunk track and green fill with a head (glyph, label, value on the drum). The fill rises on the settle spring and drains on the release spring; it holds and dims when paused, takes the failed ink when it fails, and turns the head to its result when complete. Shapes: bar, slim, ring, steps, buffered; regular and compact.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/progress.md. SwiftUI: MetalProgress in the MetalUI Swift package.
